name: HD-EPIC
tagline: 41 h of multi-day Aria recordings in 9 kitchens: 59K actions at 263 annotations/min, digital-twin scenes and a 26K-question VQA.

annotations.coverageNote: Every video is narrated (59K actions, 69 recipes); 20K object movements, 37K 3D-lifted masks, 51K audio events and gaze priming are annotated across the 41 h.

narrations.note: 59K 'how & why' narrations with start/end, verbs, nouns and hands used

action_labels.note: Verb/noun/pair classes per narration; recipe steps and high-level activities

object_boxes.note: 20K object-movement tracks with 2D boxes at pick-up and put-down

segmentation.note: 37K object masks lifted to 3D; 7.7M hand masks

hand_pose.note: Masks only; Aria MPS wrist/palm positions ship in SLAM-and-Gaze, no finger joints

gaze.note: Per-frame 2D gaze centre + 3D direction; gaze-priming events per object

camera_pose.note: Per-frame device-to-world transforms + Aria calibration (intermediate data)

scene_3d.note: Digital twins of the 9 kitchens with 413 fixtures; 3D object locations

qa_language.note: VQA: 26K 5-way questions on recipes, nutrition, actions, 3D, motion and gaze
